scientific_integrity: A finite integer upper-bound certificate and explicit matching cyclic witness can be checked with standard-library Python. The mathematical proof uses local identities proved directly from cycle balance and reversal exclusions; no external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for binary orientable cyclic sequences of order eight only; no claim about higher orders, uniqueness, or all maximizers. The 1993 original chapter was not inspected in full; equivalently phrased unindexed earlier results are a residual priority risk.
title: Sharp period of binary orientable sequences of order eight
